from_array(values: int[]) -> Collections.List[int] is

text_of(values: Collections.List[int]) -> string is

    for value in values do
        texts.add("{value}")
    od

    return texts |> join(" ")
si

binomial_transform(values: Collections.List[int], forward: bool)
        -> Collections.List[int] is
    let result = LIST()

    for n in 0..values.count do
        let total mut = 0
        let coefficient mut = 1

        for k in 0::n do

            coefficient = coefficient * (n - k) / (k + 1)
        od

        result.add(total)
    od

    return result
si

    write_line("{name}:")
    write_line("  original:   {text_of(original)}")
